gold: FIP1L1-PDGFRA–positive chronic eosinophilic leukemia (CEL) with associated generalized eruptive histiocytosis (GEH)

selector.rationale: The patient's presentation of asymptomatic red to brown macules and papules, symmetrically distributed and without coalescence, along with laboratory findings of hypereosinophilia, elevated tryptase, and elevated vitamin B12, supports the diagnosis of Hypereosinophilic syndrome. The presence of the FIP1L1-PDGFRA fusion gene on RT-PCR further supports this diagnosis.

rejected.label: Eosinophilic Disorder
rejected.why: While the patient has eosinophilia, the specific diagnosis of Hypereosinophilic syndrome is more precise and better explains the findings.

rejected.label: Histiocytosis
rejected.why: The skin biopsy showed nodular infiltration of histiocytes, but the overall clinical and laboratory picture is more consistent with Hypereosinophilic syndrome.

rejected.label: Eosinophilic dermatosis
rejected.why: The patient's skin findings are part of a larger systemic syndrome, making Eosinophilic dermatosis less likely as a primary diagnosis.
